title: Annotation rubrics and construct validity
outcome: Turn an intended capability into auditable labels, distinguish disagreement from missing evidence, and preserve adjudication history.

exercises.title: Separate a missing dimension
exercises.task: Score one level 2 criterion and one inapplicable criterion.
exercises.answer: Inapplicable is not the same as failure. The score is 2 divided by 2, while criterion coverage must be reported separately.

exercises.title: Add a critical failure
exercises.task: Give a response all level 2 quality labels but a failed access gate.
exercises.hint: Quality and required constraints use separate logic.
exercises.answer: A weighted mean cannot turn a known access violation into an acceptable result.

exercises.title: Reject malformed labels
exercises.task: Supply Boolean True as an ordinal rubric level.
exercises.hint: Python bool is an int subclass unless checked deliberately.
exercises.answer: An explicit label contract prevents accidental coercion of pass/fail fields into ordinal categories.

exercises.title: Retain reviewer disagreement
exercises.task: Adjudicate labels 1 and 2 to final label 1.
exercises.expected: Both original labels remain in the ledger.
exercises.answer: The final operational label is a new observation with a reason, not a replacement for disagreement evidence.

exercises.title: Change the rubric version
exercises.task: Combine labels from v1 and v2 without a crosswalk.
exercises.hint: A label value only has meaning under its rubric.
exercises.answer: A version change can alter category boundaries. Reannotation or a defensible crosswalk is required before aggregation.

exercises.title: Construct a proxy counterexample
exercises.task: Write a citation-looking response whose cited passage is irrelevant.
exercises.expected: Formatting succeeds while evidence support fails.
exercises.hint: Separate the marker from the claim-passage relation.
exercises.answer: The counterexample exposes a validity failure in a citation-marker metric even when annotators can apply it consistently.
